team: Week 1 kickoff: Will is first on the board with Monday done, and Fred's log is still empty. Fred, Tuesday's 400s are your chance to answer back.

fred.headline: Kickoff week, get your first log in
fred.summary: Week 1 started today and you have no sessions or benchmarks logged yet, so there is nothing to grade. That is normal on day one. This week is about ticking off the five sessions and logging each one so the coach has real numbers next Monday.
strengths: 27 week plan locked in with a clear 1:25 target for Brisbane
Monday checklist already open in the app
weaknesses: No sessions logged yet in week 1
No benchmarks recorded, so your starting level is unknown
tips: Log every session right after you finish: duration, run km, RPE and knee score take 30 seconds.
Tuesday is 6 x 400 m at 5k pace with 90 s rest. Aim for even splits, not a hero first rep.
Add your weights to the notes, e.g. Loads (kg): Trap bar 100 (3/3) · Sled push 80 (20+), so next week's loads can be set for you.

will.headline: Kickoff done, time to add weight
will.summary: Monday is logged: 40 min, 1 km at 5:30 per km, RPE 3, knee 2. Trap bar and sled at 90 lb felt easy, so there is room to load up. Log Tue, Thu, Fri and Sat to reach the 8 km run target for week 1.
strengths: First session done on day one of the plan
1 km at 5:30 per km is already faster than 1:25 goal pace (about 5:53 per km)
RPE 3 shows plenty of headroom on the strength work
weaknesses: 1 of 8 km run so far this week
Knee already at 2 in week 1, worth watching on lunges and sled
tips: Log loads in this format: Loads (lb): Trap bar 90 (3/3) · Sled push 90 (20+). It lets the coach track sets and EMOM rest properly.
If knee pain reaches 4 on any station, stop that station and swap to sled push or step ups. Get the MCL looked at before week 9 if it keeps showing up.
Saturday half sim at 75%: keep the four 500 m runs within 10 to 15 s of each other.

tweaks.text: RPE 3 at 90 lb means go heavier: trap bar DL 3 x 5 at 100 lb and sled push at 110 lb.
